messages:
ada: quick logistics thread for Saturday's handheld handoff / micro-lan in Commons 2-5pm — planning to keep it low-key: BYO handhelds, cartridges, SD swaps, and chargers.
mika: i'm bringing a Steam Deck + spare SD card adapter. can lend for short swaps but ill need it back by 4:30.
owen: i'll bring a small label maker so we can tag donated cables. last time someone grabbed my proprietary charger by accident.
rachel: can we have a 10-minute slot for a quick "etiquette + no-roms" spiel? want to remind folks about licensed software only.
kevin: yep. also please bring tiny zip locks or cases for loose SD cards. i've lost two in sofa cushions before.
nada: (meant to ping ada)
ada: whoops wrong channel.
ada: ada — can you reserve a table near outlets? the back corner has a lamp but no plugs.
setup-bot: lookup: Commons room A/B outlet map attached. Recommended: Table C near outlet bank 4.
ada: thanks bot. i'll snag Table C.
mika: small PSA for Steam Deck users: if you switch to airplane mode and enable bluetooth-only, your battery lasts way longer between rounds.
kevin: two practical tips:
1) label your charger with initials and a coloured tape.
2) bring a tiny power strip — there are only 3 desk outlets.

owen: short helper if someone needs to mount an SD on mac/linux:
```
# list block devices
lsblk -f
# mount as needed (mac uses diskutil)
```
rachel: agreed on etiquette. i'll prep a 60s slide: controllers sanitized between users, no hot-swapping firmware, and respect save files.
nada: volunteers for teardown/cleanup? i can stay till 5:30.
mika: i can help pack up docks and cables.
kevin: i'll take the charger bin.
calendar-bot: "Handheld Handoff + Micro-LAN" created by ada for Sat 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM. Location: Commons Table C.
ada: also tiny signup: 6 player slots max for any single game so we don't monopolize the table. i'll post a quick sheet.
owen: want a small token prize for the most vintage handheld brought? sticker pack?
rachel: stickers and a tiny enamel pin sounds perfect. ada can you bring the pin stash?
ada: yes i have the micro-pins. vintage category winner gets one.
mika: last note — if anyone needs a USB-A to SD adapter i have 3, first come first serve.
kevin: reminder: label everything, be kind to batteries, and no cables left on the floor. see you Saturday! :handshake: :game_die:
